package: INBOX-NASLOV (owner, phone round of 2026-10-08: notifications such as 'Dogovor je otkazan' did not say which task): public.rpc_list_inbox returns taskTitle beside every item - the title of the task (need) the event is about (NEED: that need; RESPONSE: the need of that application; AGREEMENT: the need of that Dogovor), only for the requester of that need, the worker of that application, a party of that Dogovor, the worker an OPPORTUNITY_AVAILABLE offered it to, or (NEED events) a worker who applied to it; null for any other entity kind, a missing row, a task an account closure erased ('Obrisan zadatak' / 'OBRISANO') and anyone without that right. ONE REPLACED body (prosrc b7928c50 -> bd46f06f, pg_get_functiondef 4a9f079a -> 4897d93c), three anchored edits; signature, STABLE, SECURITY DEFINER, search_path, owner, ACL, comment, every other key, order, paging, unreadCount and errors unchanged. No table, column, trigger, policy, index or grant changed.

The statement was typed into the connector and the DATABASE measured the typed text first (select md5(t), length(t), octet_length(t) from a dollar-quoted literal): md5 daf74018ea60c8716f13ebe234b89293, 12409 characters, 12409 bytes, equal to the file (pure ASCII, LF only). method.insideTheStatement: Pre-guards in the same transaction: not already or partially applied; the reader pinned (prosrc md5, pg_get_functiondef md5, SECURITY DEFINER, STABLE, owner postgres, plpgsql, jsonb, search_path=pg_catalog, ACL, no comment); the dependency body pin; 15 columns with type and not-null; the erasure markers in private.closure_redaction_patch_v5; certificate ready. Then the body is replaced only after the preimage md5, the payload md5 bd46f06f..., the definition md5 and exactly one anchor of the old body are asserted, and the whole pg_proc row apart from the body plus the comment are asserted unchanged with the new definition md5 4897d93c.... Post-guards: the reader pinned again, the dependency pin, both closure digests equal before and after (a temporary table of the pre-apply digests), the certificate ready. Every refusal is errcode 55000; any difference aborts and rolls back.

notProven: The app on a phone: the client already reads taskTitle (commit 6c78480e, inboxClientService keeps it, inboxCopy shows it as the second line); the next APK shows it.
Speed on DEV beyond the smoke: measured on CI hardware with 10,000 notifications.
A real account closure end to end: the redaction was proven with the certified erasure function on the disposable chain.
followUps: Deliberate difference from RLS (accepted for the owner's request): a worker who applied to a task that was then cancelled sees that task's title in the cancellation notification, though RLS no longer shows the task itself; blocks are not consulted (the title only).
The title shown is today's title of the task, not the title at the moment of the event.
The production Supabase project (decision R04) needs this package before its first real user.
